mathematical_meanings: Left image: The symbol "O" marks the center of the indicated circle. Right image: The symbol "O" marks the origin at the intersection of the coordinate axes.
Rationales: The left occurrence is O beside the black dot inside the large circle. The right occurrence is O just below the crossing of the x- and y-axes. The left placement shows that the symbol marks the center of the indicated circle, while the right placement shows that it marks the origin at the intersection of the coordinate axes.
